summary: Bradbury Capital Inc. (formerly TETE Technologies Inc.) filed a 6-K reporting the October 6, 2026 closing of its business combination with Technology Telecommunication Acquisition Corporation, a Cayman Islands SPAC, and Bradbury Capital Holdings Inc. The combined company renamed Bradbury Capital Inc., with ordinary shares and warrants expected to trade on Nasdaq under BBCI and BBCIW from October 7, 2026. A concurrent PIPE of 625,000 ordinary shares raised US$5,000,000 (US$8.00 per share) from an investor whose sole shareholder is CEO Loo See Yuen. Watch post-deSPAC trading, redemptions, and related-party PIPE governance.
